story.text: One evening a lifelike {GHOST} leans over Jo’s chair: Laurie, home from {EUROPE}, with Amy his {BRIDE}! Then comes a {KNOCK}, and there stands Professor Bhaer. “O Mr. Bhaer, I am so {GLAD} to see you!” Father and he talk {PHILOSOPHY} all evening, and he fits in as if he had always been there.
story.caption: “O Mr. Bhaer, I am so glad to see you!”
